prompt: A photorealistic photo captures a bustling mountain campsite scene. In the center foreground, a woman in a yellow raincoat sits on a weathered wooden log, her posture relaxed as she holds a steaming metal mug. To her left, a man in a blue beanie stands next to a large green tent, his hand pointing toward the distant peaks. A brown dog lies beside the tent entrance, its head resting on its paws while looking at the man. On the right side of the frame, a child in an orange jacket reaches out to touch the fur of a gray cat that sits calmly on a camping chair. Behind them, a teenager in a black hoodie leans against a silver cooler, observing the group with a slight smile. Near the fire pit, an older man with white hair tends to the glowing embers using a long metal poker. A young girl in a pink hat stands next to him, holding a marshmallow on a stick. A red backpack rests on the ground near the fire, partially obscured by shadows. A pair of hiking boots lies discarded near the log where the woman sits. A lantern hangs from a tree branch above the group, casting a soft glow despite the daylight. A map is spread out on a folding table in the background, weighted down by a compass and a water bottle. A second tent, this one blue, is pitched further back near the tree line. A bicycle leans against a pine tree on the far left edge of the scene. There is no snow on the ground. There is no visible smoke rising from the fire.
